retiredSecondaryRoutes.policy: Removed from D2 INTEGRATION_MAP and fail-loud in render-runtime. Manual backup and history are canonical owner states/overlays; automatic backup is part of backup-settings. There is no dual renderer or state owner.

semanticSlot.dataControlToken: identity-only token; excluded from UiEvent schema and native enums

r2aInstrumentation.identityPolicy: All 92 declarations use stable business settingsKey values. Ordinals, selector hashes, labels and DOM order are prohibited. Unknown identity fails closed.

guards: only one async request may be pending; duplicate starts resolve duplicate
completion requires the current requestId, kind and requestEpoch
cancel increments requestEpoch, clears pending, and later completion resolves stale
manual backup confirmation/history state stay inside the canonical owner

ariaAndFocus.switches: role=switch, aria-checked, keyboard focus and accessible label
ariaAndFocus.dialogs: role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby and deterministic data-dialog-initial-focus
ariaAndFocus.focusReturn: overlay triggers retain exact data-restore-focus business keys
ariaAndFocus.loading: aria-busy=true and disabled on the submitting control; cancellation remains separately reachable
ariaAndFocus.error: aria-invalid=true with the async error exposed as the control title
ariaAndFocus.remoteAndRestoreRows: keyboard reachable role=button controls with stable identity

figmaReadOnlyBaseline.knownStructuralGap: The responsive master subtree was read as INSTANCE=0 during F0 preparation. The serial writer must replace raw internals through canonical component instances, preserve downstream instances/reactions, and record exact Page 23 node ids at the fresh revision.

figmaDecisionsRequired: Update shared Switch/Select/Stepper/dialog/loading/error primitives before page masters; all trailing choices and values are right-aligned.
Repair Phone and Tablet masters only. Landscape inherits Tablet; do not create Compact or Fold structures.
Represent manual backup/history as states or overlays of the canonical owner; do not recreate the retired routes as a second flow.
Repair Page 24 masters through real component instances, then let Page 23 instances inherit. Detached frames and screenshots are prohibited.
Preserve existing reactions and downstream instances. Figma may not change UiEvent, controlIdentityToken, reducer ownership, async guards or business flow.
